apps.name: AirBeep
apps.subtitle: 静音通话录音提示音
apps.localizedDescription: 把 iOS 通话录音的开始与结束提示音替换成等长静音：一个开关完成替换，替换前会自动备份原文件（备份永不覆盖），并支持一键还原；每次写入都会回读校验。支持英文与简体中文界面。

versions.localizedDescription:
## [2.5.2] - 2026-10-19

### English / Added
- **Check tone status button.** The current tone state can now be checked on
  demand from the home screen. The read channel is unreliable on some iOS
  releases (the AirTraffic move step never completes there), so the check
  reports one of three outcomes: silenced, originals still in place, or
  unverifiable on this device. It never runs automatically and never gates an
  operation.

### English / Changed
- After silencing, the success alert no longer claims a verified result when
  the read-back could not confirm it; it says the silence was written but
  unverified and points at the tone status check. This covers the
  [issue #6](https://github.com/LinkPass888/AirBeep/issues/6) report where the
  write channel returns success on iOS 27.x while the tones never change.

---

### 中文 / 新增
- **校验提示音状态按钮。** 可在首页按需检测当前提示音状态。部分 iOS 版本上
  读取通道不可靠（AirTraffic 搬运步骤始终无法完成），因此检测结果分为三种：
  已静音、原始提示音仍在、本机无法校验。该检测绝不自动运行，也不会阻断
  任何操作。

### 中文 / 变更
- 静音后的成功弹窗在回读校验无法确认时不再直接宣称成功，改为提示"静音
  已写入、结果未经校验"，并引导使用提示音状态校验。对应
  [issue #6](https://github.com/LinkPass888/AirBeep/issues/6) 反馈的
  iOS 27.x 上写入通道返回成功但提示音实际未变的问题。

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/LinkPass888/AirBeep/compare/v2.5.1...v2.5.2

apps.name: AirCard-iOS
apps.subtitle: Apple Wallet card skins and lock screen themes
apps.localizedDescription: Customise Apple Wallet card artwork, the lock screen passcode dialer and PosterBoard wallpapers on device, without a jailbreak. AirCard-iOS talks to Apple's internal services through the LocalDevVPN loopback tunnel, which has to be installed as well.

versions.localizedDescription:
## What's Changed in v1.3.2 🚀

This update brings full feature parity with AirCard macOS v1.2.6, restores robust card discovery across all iOS versions, introduces automatic bank/network recognition with custom card nicknames, delivers an ultra-fast tunnel cache (0.02s connections), and completely resolves wallpaper flashing for Collections and Mercury wallpapers.

### 💳 Wallet Card Discovery & Bank Identification
• **Universal Wallet Log Parser**: Ported the proven `WalletScanParser` from AirCard macOS. Captures cards from `Dashboard loading (...): for SOO+`, `passIDs[InSession]`, `passIDs[global]`, and modern JSON NFC activations (`"identifier": "HEX"`).
• **Automatic Bank & Network Detection**: Recognizes Visa, Mastercard, American Express, UnionPay, Discover, and JCB via applet AIDs during selection.
• **Card Nicknames (Rename)**: Added a direct **Rename** button (✏️) so you can give your cards friendly names like *"Monobank"*, *"Salary Card"*, or *"Revolut"*, safely persisted in app settings.
• **28-Character Fallback Token Matcher**: Restores dependable card discovery on devices where standard log patterns are redacted.

### ⚡ Ultra-Fast Tunnel Routing (from 10s to 0.02s!)
• **Working Route Caching**: `rust-core` now caches the active RSD connection route (`LAST_WORKING_ROUTE`), eliminating repeated port and interface scanning.
• **RSD-First Priority**: Connects directly via RemoteXPC on port 49152, bypassing slow Lockdown retries and broken pipes on iOS 18+.
• **Eliminated Loopback Policy Drops**: Removed local loopback attempts that caused `policy drop` control channel errors.

### 🖼 Wallpapers (.tendies) — Collections & Mercury Fixes
• **Dual Injection on iOS 18+**: Wallpapers are now injected into both their primary bundle (`com.apple.WallpaperKit.CollectionsPoster` or `com.apple.MercuryPoster`) and the modern iOS 18+ application container (`com.apple.Posters.CollectionsPosterApp` / `com.apple.Posters.MercuryPosterApp`).
• **Metadata Synchronization**: Fixed a critical issue where `Wallpaper.plist`'s numeric identifier was randomized out-of-sync with `suggestionMetadata.plist` (`7400.DYNAMIC`), causing wallpapers like Windows 11 to vanish from the Lock Screen gallery.
• **Mercury Wallpaper Support**: Added recognition for `mercury-descriptors` container folders and registered `com.apple.Posters.MercuryPosterApp` in `PersistedPosterContainerBundleIdentifiers`.
• **NeoSpring Respring**: Instant springboard reload to apply wallpaper preferences immediately.

### 🧪 Quality & Testing
• All 24 unit tests passing (`TendiesEngineTests`, `WalletScanParserTests`, `CardPhotoCropTests`, `CardPhotoPickerTests`).

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Mak5er/AirCard-iOS/compare/v1.3.1...v1.3.2

apps.name: Asspp
apps.subtitle: Multi-region App Store manager
apps.localizedDescription: Manage multiple Apple IDs across App Store regions from one app: switch stores instantly, browse and search any region, download official signed IPAs for backup or sideloading, and pull older versions of an app when you need them.

versions.localizedDescription:
## Changes

- Recover downloads when Apple returns an empty HTTP 500 by retrying the version-pinned request through the bag’s update endpoint.
- Update ApplePackage to 2.0.3 with Swift 6.2 compatibility fixes.
- Report Keychain save failures before completing login, and preserve stored data when loading fails.
- Improve empty account layout, editable device identifiers, and account table column widths.
- Remove personal metadata from bundled installation certificates and omit the CA private key.
- Explicitly clear development teams for release builds and check packaged artifacts before publication.

## Installation certificate

The local installation CA was replaced to remove personal metadata. If you use OTA installation, install and trust the new certificate from Settings after updating.

The release contains an unsigned iOS IPA and a macOS ZIP without a personal development team.

apps.name: CiliCili
apps.subtitle: SwiftUI 第三方 B 站客户端
apps.localizedDescription: 使用 SwiftUI 编写的第三方 B 站客户端实验项目：首页推荐、搜索、UP 主空间、动态（图文/视频/转发）、视频详情与 HLS 播放、弹幕（开关、样式、关键词过滤）、评论与私信，并支持二维码与网页登录（登录态保存在本机 Keychain）。

versions.localizedDescription:
## 这版更新了啥

- 首页推荐和动态都可以点底栏回到顶部，到顶后再点一次就刷新。动态下拉也会直接获取新内容。
- 动态页顶部可以自选显示哪些频道，还能调整顺序。
- 长动态和长评论可以点末行的「… 展开」，直接看全文。
- 播放器新增 CC 字幕入口，可以选字幕轨，也能设置 AI 字幕偏好。横屏播放的设置移到右侧，屏幕顶部左右分别显示时间和电量。
- 分 P、番剧选集和合集换成了带封面的紧凑列表。视频详情里的头像和操作按钮也重新排过，更容易区分。

## 修了哪些问题

- 优化评论滚动和翻页，修了切换「最热／最新」时出现的大块空白和加载占位盖住排序栏的问题。
- 修正部分 HDR 视频的显示和弹幕设置，并补充了部分视频取流失败时的重试方式。
- 调整搜索筛选栏和投币面板，投币时可以选择是否同时点赞。

## 安装包

- 附件里的 `bili-release-unsigned.ipa` 是 1.1.3（Build 150）的未签名安装包，需自行签名后安装。

apps.subtitle: 系统配置与 MobileGestalt 工具箱
apps.localizedDescription: 基于 worse_query 的简体中文 iOS/iPadOS 系统配置与 MobileGestalt 研究工具箱，支持写入前差异预览、备份校验、写后读回与自动回滚，并支持一键恢复原厂参数。iOS/iPadOS 27 完整支持，26.x 部分支持。

versions.localizedDescription:
## Erosion-CN v0.8.6 更新日志 (Build 21)

### 🚀 容器极速枚举修复 & 空间音频硬件防呆解耦 & 分流规则增强

1. **修复高 Inode 主力机容器扫描卡死 5–6 分钟，并适配 `iOS 26.3.x` `CSStore2` 秒开（修复 #21）**：
   - **修正 `pathleak` 上限保护逻辑**：修复长期使用的设备（累计 APFS 单调递增 Inode 超过 2 亿）在回退 `pathleak` 时外层 `min/max` 写反导致 `15,000,000` 上限失效、强行遍历 2.28 亿次系统调用的问题；
   - **新增不依赖结构体偏移的 `CSStore2` 书签 TLV（`NSURL minimalBookmark`）兜底提取引擎**：在 `iOS 26.3.x` 与 `iOS 27.x` 上均可直接从 `.csstore` 提取并校验有效的应用数据（`Application`）、扩展插件（`PluginKitPlugin`）、应用共享组（`AppGroup`）与守护进程（`InternalDaemon`）容器路径，无论容器 Inode 高低均可秒级加载。

2. **拆分「FaceTime 空间音频」与「空间音频录制」，新增非四麦克风机型自动防呆（修复 #19）**：
   - 将原合并开关拆分为独立的 **「FaceTime 空间音频」**（`spatial-facetime-audio`，纯软件声场渲染，兼容 `iPhone 15 Pro` 及更早机型）与 **「空间音频录制（相机 / 语音备忘录录音室）」**（`spatial-audio-recording`）；
   - 对非四麦克风阵列旧机型（`iPhone 15` 系列及更早三麦克风机型）默认自动防呆锁定关闭「空间音频录制」，避免语音备忘录出现无效的「录音室 (Studio)」档位并点录音即停（旧版已开启用户升级后可直接一键关闭恢复）。

3. **修正屏幕子类型 (Subtype) 数值与多项交互提示优化（#14 / #15 / #17 / #13）**：
   - 修正上游遗留的「屏幕子类型」数值笔误（`iPhone 14 Pro / 15 Pro` 修正为 `2556`，`iPhone 14 Pro Max / 15 Pro Max` 修正为 `2796`）并消除重复 Tag 冲突；
   - 补充 iOS 26/27 下解除 `green-tea` 同样会切换国际版网络权限（隐藏单应用「不允许联网」）的说明，并针对侧载签名剥离 `App Group` 导致的 `result: -1` 新增专属中文排障弹窗；
   - 更新内置 `Surge (.sgmodule)` 与 `Stash (.stoverride)` 分流生成器，补齐 Apple PCC 速率限制匿名令牌签发域名（`mask-api.icloud.com` / `mask.icloud.com` / `mask-h2.icloud.com`）与相册云端消除网关（`*.app.apple.com`）。

---

### 📦 安装包校验信息

- **文件名**：`Erosion_v0.8.6_zh-Hans.ipa`
- **版本号**：`v0.8.6` (`Build 21`)

apps.name: iPadn
apps.subtitle: 在 iPhone 和 iPad 上管理已购 App
apps.localizedDescription: 在 iPhone 和 iPad 上搜索、下载并安装你已拥有的 App，支持历史版本、已下架应用、多地区比价、已购项目与一键安装。

versions.localizedDescription:
## iPadn 2.1.0

本次更新为历史版本加入对应版本的真实图标与 IPA 大小，完善下载交互、自动安装和本机应用详情，并修复侧滑裁剪、重复安装排队及搜索标签圆角问题。安装包未签名，请用自己的工具签名后安装。

### 历史版本

- 新增起止日期范围查询（包含结束日全天），逐步检查当前来源提供的版本，显示进度并支持取消、清除筛选；失败或日期未知会明确提示结果不完整，不按版本 ID 猜日期，也不会遇到一条范围外的日期就停止。包内时间戳标记为「包内日期」，不等同于商店发布日期。
- 展开和筛选结果按每批 20 条追加；可见历史行延迟触发读取，滑离时取消排队，先显示版本资料再补图标。图标在后台解码，并以最多 80 张 / 8 MiB 的内存缓存减少反复滚动的开销。日期扫描不主动读取图标。

- 每个历史版本行内显示从对应 IPA 提取的主图标，便于比较活动角标；按需局部读取、分版本缓存，未获取时显示占位，不使用最新版商店图标代替。仅存储在 Assets.car 中的图标暂不支持。
- 显示每个版本对应的 IPA 安装包大小，而不是套用最新版的大小；读取已有元数据即可取得远端完整包大小，无需先下载整个安装包。
- 版本号、日期、大小和版本 ID 分层显示，大字体下自动纵向排列。
- 长按版本行，通过系统菜单复制版本号或版本 ID；点击菜单外即可收起。
- 兼容旧元数据缓存；无法读取大小时显示「—」。大小是远端原始 IPA 的长度，可能与下载处理后的本地文件略有差异。

### 下载与操作体验

- 下载卡片侧滑可删除或分享，分享文件名包含应用名称与版本号。
- 修复侧滑时卡片边缘被裁剪、快速滑动后分享按钮短暂变灰的问题；整张圆角卡片一起移动，收起后恢复原样。
- 点侧滑操作以外的位置即可收起，不会顺带触发下面的按钮。修正掉帧时弹簧动画推进过慢、收起后操作恢复延迟的问题。
- 删除后的 5 秒撤销提示显示剩余秒数和进度环。
- 下载完成时进度环转为勾号，再显示「安装」；任务长按保留原生系统菜单。
- 再点当前标签页可回到列表顶部，切换其他标签仍保留原来的滚动位置。

### 自动安装与实时活动

- 开启「下载完成后自动安装」并选择「原生安装」时，完成的下载依次直接安装，无需再次确认。需事先完成配对，并保持 LocalDevVPN 连接；其他安装方式仍需打开 iPadn 完成确认。
- 下载到安装期间保留静音音频后台保活；标准版的锁屏和灵动岛实时活动可显示下载、处理和安装状态。后台运行仍受 iOS 管理，应用被系统终止时不能保证继续；重新打开后恢复待办。
- 修复安装中切回前台可能将同一任务再次加入队列；隔离预览模式的安装待办记录，避免影响正式数据。

### 搜索与稳定性

- 最近搜索改为标签显示，可在设置中关闭搜索页的「发现」。
- 修复最近搜索标签换行后左侧圆角被列表裁剪的问题，保留原生长按菜单。
- 本机应用分组改用「App Store 未识别的应用」，表述更清晰。
- 本机应用查不到商店资料时仍可点开查看已装版本、Bundle ID 等本机信息；区分当前地区未查到资料与查询失败，可独立重试商店查询，不将缺少资料直接判为下架。
- 补充历史版本大小、旧缓存迁移、长按复制、大字体与侧滑表面的回归测试；改进模拟器启动等待及撤销测试的操作时序，不改变实际撤销期限。
- 继续支持 iOS / iPadOS 16 及更新版本，各功能保留各自系统版本要求。

### 两个安装包

- `iPadn-2.1.0-unsigned.ipa`：标准版，含实时活动和小组件，签名需要 2 个 App ID。
- `iPadn-2.1.0-lite-unsigned.ipa`：精简版，不含扩展，只需 1 个 App ID；不提供实时活动或小组件，其他功能相同。
- SideStore、AltStore、Feather 等签名工具可添加源：`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mengangs/ipadn/main/altstore-source.json`。

### English

**Date-range search** includes the whole end day and checks every version returned by the current source, with progress, cancellation and explicit incomplete/unknown-date states. It does not infer dates from IDs or stop at the first out-of-range date. Package timestamps are labeled as package dates, not guaranteed store release dates. Histories and filtered results load in batches of 20; visible rows publish metadata before reading icons, cancelled rows leave the queue promptly, and background-decoded images share a bounded 80-image / 8 MiB cache. The date scan itself does not fetch icons.

**Version history** now shows each version’s own primary icon extracted from its IPA, alongside the remote IPA size of that individual version, using partial metadata reads rather than downloading the whole package or reusing the latest listing's size. Version, date, size and ID are separated, with a vertical layout for accessibility text sizes. Long-press a row to copy its version number or ID using the system menu. Old caches remain compatible; unavailable sizes show “—”. The remote raw IPA size can differ slightly from the processed local download. Icon PNGs are fetched with bounded range reads and cached per platform/app/version; no full package download is needed. Missing icons use placeholders, never current store artwork. Icons stored only in Assets.car are not yet supported.

**Downloads** gain swipe-to-delete/share with app-and-version filenames, full-card movement without clipped edges, reliable Share appearance after fast swipes, and outside-tap dismissal without activating underlying controls. Spring timing follows real elapsed time so dropped frames do not prolong closing animations. Undo retains its five-second window with a countdown ring. Completion transitions to a checkmark and Install. Task long-press keeps the native menu; tapping the selected tab scrolls to the top without resetting other tabs.

**Automatic native installation** installs completed downloads sequentially without another confirmation when enabled. Pair beforehand and keep LocalDevVPN connected; other methods still need foreground confirmation. Silent audio keeps the app running from download through installation, with download/processing/install states in standard-package Live Activities. Background execution remains subject to iOS; reopening resumes pending work. Fixes duplicate queuing of an active installation on foreground return and isolates preview installation records from real data.

**Installed apps** stay inspectable even when store details are missing: open local version, Bundle ID and other device information, distinguish a missing regional listing from a failed lookup, and retry store details without reconnecting the native installation service.

Recent searches use chips with corrected wrapped rounded edges, Discover can be hidden in Settings, and regression coverage and simulator readiness are improved. iOS / iPadOS 16 remains supported, subject to each feature's requirements. Both unsigned packages are available: standard includes Live Activities/widgets and needs two App IDs; lite has no extension and needs one. Sign with your own tool before installing.

更早版本的更新内容见 [Releases](https://github.com/mengangs/ipadn/releases)。

两个安装包：`iPadn-2.1.0-unsigned.ipa` 是标准版（含实时活动和桌面小组件，需要 2 个 App ID）；`iPadn-2.1.0-lite-unsigned.ipa` 是精简版（不含扩展，只需 1 个 App ID），适合 App ID 数量受限的签名方式。

验证：设备 Release 编译与 IPA 检查通过；162 项测试通过，0 项失败，0 项跳过。

apps.name: Kumone
apps.subtitle: 原生 NetEase Cloud Music iOS 客户端（雲の音）
apps.localizedDescription:
Kumone（雲の音）— native NetEase Cloud Music client for iOS. Talks directly to NetEase's real API with no third-party server: QR-code login, gray-track unblocking, synced lyrics with translation, immersive artwork-tinted now-playing, and playlist management.

Supports English and Simplified Chinese localization.

versions.localizedDescription:
### Added

- **Comments**: read a song's comments from its context menu, or on iOS from the now-playing page's More menu — top comments first, then the latest, loading more as you scroll, with the reply each one answers and its likes. Signed in, you can like a comment or take the like back (#113).
- **Search**: on iOS every playlist can be searched (the magnifying glass, or pull down), not only Liked Songs; tapping a result plays the whole playlist from that song (#185).
- **Cloud Disk**: search by song, artist, album or uploaded file name, on macOS and iOS. The cloud disk now loads every song instead of the first 1,000, so search and Play All cover them all (#186).

### Improved

- **iOS**: Daily Recs drops the large cover banner at the top, so the songs start right below the date, title and Play All.

---

### 新增

- **评论**：从歌曲的右键 / 长按菜单，或 iOS 播放页的「更多」菜单查看歌曲评论——先显示热门评论，再显示最新评论，滚动时自动加载更多，并显示所回复的评论和点赞数。登录后可以给评论点赞或取消点赞（#113）。
- **搜索**：iOS 上所有歌单都可以在歌单内搜索（右上角放大镜，或在列表顶部下拉），不再只限「我喜欢的音乐」；点搜索结果会从这首开始播放整个歌单（#185）。
- **音乐云盘**：macOS 和 iOS 都可以按歌名、歌手、专辑或上传的文件名搜索。云盘现在会加载全部歌曲，不再只加载前 1000 首，搜索和「播放全部」都覆盖所有歌曲（#186）。

### 改进

- **iOS**：每日推荐去掉了顶部的大封面横幅，日期、标题和「播放全部」下面直接就是歌曲列表。

apps.name: MiniWatts
apps.subtitle: Battery, charging and thermal instrument for iPhone
apps.localizedDescription: A battery, charging and thermal instrument for iPhone, built on Apple's private power-management APIs. It shows what the charger is delivering, how much of it reaches the cell, where the rest goes as heat, and what the phone's temperature sensors are doing while it happens.

versions.localizedDescription:
Unsigned build — sign it with your own Apple ID before installing.
https://github.com/ResistanceTo/MiniWatts#install

## 改进

- **温度可以显示为华氏度。** 设置 → 单位 里可选"自动 / °C / °F"。"自动"跟随系统地区，以及"设置 › 通用 › 语言与地区"里的"温度"选项，所以地区使用华氏度的用户升级后会直接看到 °F。App 各页、图表、热力图、悬浮读数、实时活动和小组件都按所选单位显示；原始数据仍显示传感器给出的 °C。(#25)
- **充电预估。** 充电时，功率页会显示充到 80% 和充到 100% 还要多久，以及大约几点。时间根据电量实际上升的速度推算，不依赖电池能量设置；要等电量变化两次才会出现，通常需要几分钟。80% 以后按典型充电曲线估算，只是近似值。(#27)
- **显示版本号。** 设置 → 关于 里显示当前版本，原始数据导出的第一行也带上了版本号。(#27)
- **iPad 布局。** iPad 横屏和 13 英寸竖屏时，各页分成两栏；窄屏时仍是一栏。历史记录里单次充电的详情页在 iPad 上不再横向铺满。(#22)
- **iPad 热力图。** 在 iPad 上，发热页画的是 iPad 的轮廓，各区域按 iPad Pro 11 英寸的内部布局放置：主板在中间，两侧是电芯，充电芯片在 USB-C 接口旁。设备页和设置里的图标也换成了 iPad。(#13, #22)

## 修复

- 发热：CPU 簇（`pACC`、`eACC`）和图像处理器（`ISP`）等传感器以前被归入"其他传感器"，现在算作 SoC，SoC 区域的温度也会把它们算进去。iPhone 11 上 `FrontCameraDie`、`BCMLBSkin` 这类名字连写的传感器以前会被分错区（比如前摄像头被当成机身），现在会先拆词再归类。(#13, #14)
- 适配器页里"单次采样"那段说明以前在中文界面下一直显示英文，现在已有中文。

## 注意

- iPad 相关的改动只在模拟器里验证过，我手上没有 iPad。如果在 iPad 上看到问题，请从 设置 → 原始数据 复制导出并反馈。
- iPad 上"来自充电器"的功率偏低（#13）这次还没有修：要确认其余的输入由哪个传感器测量，需要一份**充电时**导出的原始数据。有 iPad 的话，请在充电时从 设置 → 原始数据 复制导出，贴到 #13。
- 充电预估无法知道是否开启了充电上限或优化电池充电。如果开着，电池会在上限前停下，"充到 100%"的时间就不准。

---

## Improvements

- **Temperatures can be shown in Fahrenheit.** Settings → Units offers Automatic, °C or °F. Automatic follows your region and the Temperature option under Settings › General › Language & Region, so if your region uses Fahrenheit you will see °F straight after updating. Every page, the charts, the heat map, the floating meter, the Live Activity and the widget follow the setting; Raw data still shows the sensors' own °C. (#25)
- **Charge forecast.** While charging, the Power page shows how long until 80% and until 100%, and roughly when. It is worked out from how fast the battery level is actually rising, so it does not depend on the battery energy setting; it appears once the level has moved twice, usually within a few minutes. Past 80% it follows a typical charging curve and is approximate. (#27)
- **Version number.** Settings → About shows the installed version, and the first line of the Raw data dump includes it. (#27)
- **iPad layout.** On an iPad in landscape, and a 13-inch in portrait, every page uses two columns; narrower windows keep one. A session's detail page in History no longer stretches edge to edge on an iPad. (#22)
- **iPad heat map.** On an iPad the Thermal page draws an iPad, with the zones placed as in an iPad Pro 11-inch: logic board down the middle, a battery cell either side, the charge IC by the USB-C port. The Devices page and Settings use iPad icons too. (#13, #22)

## Fixes

- Thermal: the CPU-cluster (`pACC`, `eACC`) and image-processor (`ISP`) sensors used to land under "Other sensors"; they now count as the SoC, and the SoC zone's temperature includes them. On an iPhone 11, run-together sensor names such as `FrontCameraDie` and `BCMLBSkin` were filed in the wrong zone (the front camera as chassis); names are now split into words before they are matched. (#13, #14)
- Adapter: the one-sample note always showed in English in the Chinese interface; it is now translated.

## Notes

- The iPad changes were checked in the simulator only — I do not have an iPad. If something looks wrong on yours, copy the dump from Settings → Raw data and report it.
- The low "from charger" reading on an iPad (#13) is not fixed yet: finding which sensor carries the rest of the input needs a Raw data dump taken **while charging**. If you have an iPad, please copy one from Settings → Raw data while it charges and post it on #13.
- The charge forecast cannot tell whether a charge limit or Optimized Battery Charging is on. If one is, the battery stops short and the time to 100% will be wrong.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ResistanceTo/MiniWatts/compare/v1.6.0...v1.7.0

apps.name: Opaline
apps.subtitle: YouTube client for iOS 12+
apps.localizedDescription: A lightweight, privacy-focused YouTube client for iOS, built with UIKit. SponsorBlock, Return YouTube Dislike, up to 1080p playback, background audio, Picture-in-Picture, subtitles and offline downloads — no ads, no tracking, no dependencies.

versions.localizedDescription:
**New**

- Hold anywhere on the video to seek ([#116](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/116)). Press and hold on the picture, then drag sideways. The seek bar follows your finger and the video jumps where you let go, so you no longer have to hit the thin bar at the bottom. The taps you already know still work: the sides seek, the middle pauses.
- Search inside a channel ([#117](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/117)). Channel pages have a magnifier now, and whatever you type there searches that channel only. YouTube serves no filters for this kind of search, so there are none in the app either.
- Get a downloaded video out of the app ([#115](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/115)). The menu on a downloaded video has a new "Save to Files" row that hands the file to the usual iOS share sheet, so it can go to Files, Photos, AirDrop or another app. It is named after the video, and only the video leaves: subtitles, comments and the saved page stay where they were.
- Clear the whole search history at once ([#121](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/121)). The last row under Recent searches wipes the list, and it asks first.

**Fixes**

- The mini player no longer sits on top of the tab bar ([#118](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/118)). Tapping a tab behind the collapsed player switches to that tab instead of reopening the video.
- Stereo no longer gets spatialized on AirPods ([#119](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/119)). Ordinary two-channel sound was being turned into a fake surround field that moved when you turned your head. Video that really is multichannel still spatializes.
- The "..." menu stops closing on its own ([#128](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/128)). It was reacting to the device being tilted or put down, which made it look random when you held the phone in your hand.

**Also**

- If your device is older than Opaline supports, the README now points at [a downport for iOS 9](https://github.com/Joeviocoe/Opaline) by another developer, which runs on the iPad 2, iPad 3, iPad mini and iPhone 4S ([#125](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/125)).

apps.localizedDescription: 无需越狱浏览 App 数据与文件，支持 Plist/十六进制编辑、应用数据备份恢复、缓存清理与 SQLite 查看。需使用保留 App Group 权限的签名工具（AltStore、SideStore 或 Impactor，不支持 Sideloadly）。

versions.localizedDescription:
> **Requires:** iOS 27, or iOS 26.0 – 26.7.2. Tested on iOS 27.0.1, 27.2.1, 26.7.1 and the 27.3 beta (confirmed by a user).
> **Needs:** a sideloading tool that keeps the App Group entitlement; see [Signing](https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles#signing-the-app-group) in the README.

# Worse Query Files 0.9.6

## New

- **Search Inside Folders…** (••• menu): finds names in all subfolders, with progress and **Stop**.
- **Largest Files** (••• menu): the 100 biggest files below a folder, to see where storage goes.
- **Get Info** (long-press): path, kind, size (folders counted), dates, owner, permissions, inode and a file's SHA-256. Tap a row to copy it.
- **Duplicate** and **Copy to Folder…** (long-press): copy files and folders, also into other apps' data, like Move.
- **Favorites:** add a folder from its ••• menu; they're listed under Tools.
- **Reopen Last Folder** ([#41](https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles/issues/41)): WQ Files starts in the folder you were in. It's a switch on the start screen.
- **Check for Updates** ([#41](https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles/issues/41)): a note on the start screen when a new version is out.
  - **What's sent:** WQ Files reads the public release list on GitHub at most twice a day and sends nothing about your device. This is its only network access.
  - **Turning it off:** use the switch on the start screen.
- **Open ZIP files by tapping them** ([#41](https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles/issues/41)): **Extract and Open** unpacks it next to itself and opens the folder. **Open as File** shows the file as before.
- **Thai** ([#52](https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles/issues/52)).

## Changed

- **SQLite save** writes through SQLite itself, which takes care of the database's journal and WAL files, so a save is safer if WQ Files is closed midway.
- **App restore** copies and checks the backup in a private folder first, and installs exactly what was checked.
- **Replace All** when importing only replaces the file versions shown in the question; a file that changed meanwhile is imported under a new name.
- **Turkish and Thai:** clearer wording.

## Fixed

- **App names and some app folders missing** on some devices (e.g. iOS 26.1): when the app database uses a layout WQ Files doesn't know, it now works out where names and folders are from the database itself, and remembers it for that iOS version. App identities, which decide where backups go, still only come from the app's own folder tag or a known layout. WQ Files also uses the newest database file when iOS keeps an old one, and the Log lists them.
- **App backups could come out empty** when WQ Files didn't have access to the app's folder yet; it worked on the second or third try. Backup now fails with "try again" instead, and an empty backup is never restored (restoring one would empty the app's data).

## Credit

Sandbox technique: [worse_query](https://github.com/forcequitOS/worse_query) by Taj C (forcequit). Container enumeration: [KAMUI](https://github.com/murk-sus/kamui-escape) by murk-sus. Translations: iosrxwy (Simplified Chinese), hfip (Arabic), hooray804 (Korean), Reinascape (Russian). Thanks to everyone who sent Logs and ideas. GPL-3.0-or-later.

SHA-256 of WQFiles.ipa: `d15feaf0fb82dd754b78de3a0e9d210db0cc1ebd83748dd1980e922d2183c2c6`

apps.subtitle: 本机虚拟定位与步行路线测试工具
apps.localizedDescription: 在一张地图上选择、测试并移动 iPhone 向系统报告的位置：支持固定位置、步行与驾车路线模拟、收藏与历史记录，结束后可恢复真实位置。它通过本机配对与设备隧道建立开发者定位会话（默认使用 LocalDevVPN）。这是 Roam Control 的非官方中文分支，仅供在你自己拥有并控制的设备上做开发与测试。

versions.localizedDescription:
优化定位维持和断线后的恢复：

- 前台开始定位时提前启动后台保活，回到前台后检查长时间未收到回调的请求。
- 运行中的定位遇到可重试连接错误时，以 1、2、4 秒间隔最多连续重连三次，沿用最新坐标。
- 重连期间冻结路线进度，恢复后保留原有暂停状态。
- 主动停止、重置和恢复真实位置会取消重连；认证错误及上次启动留下的未确认会话仍需手动处理。

versions.localizedDescription:
## 更新日志

### 新增
- 桌面端支持从账号最近发布的动态、评论中识别手机型号和系统信息，自动用于请求设备配置；无可用记录时使用 iPhone 18 Pro Max 兼容模板。
- 设备设置页展示自动识别的机型及来源。自动配置保留手动指纹和已保存的数盟设备 ID，切换账号时重新识别。
- 搜索分类支持拖动排序，并可收起不常用栏目。
- 无图模式新增详情页图片显示开关。
- 新增浅色界面底色自定义和动态背景图显示开关。
- 话题页新增我的点评卡片。
- 设置页新增“液态玻璃”总开关，默认关闭，可统一控制首页和话题导航的液态玻璃效果。

### 优化
- 移动首页滚动时可自动收起搜索栏和底部导航；详情页底栏支持随滚动隐藏。
- 优化移动端上传、下载布局，并增加 CDN 上传入口。
- 优化首页与话题的沉浸式导航，适配 Android 和 iOS 安全区，并统一上下导航的玻璃效果。
- 优化设置页窄屏和大字体下的布局。
- 设置中心统一使用一个“设置”标签，切换菜单不再新增标签，返回时打开最近访问的栏目；已有固定和收藏的设置标签自动合并。
- 隐藏桌面设置内容区与侧栏重复的栏目标题，保留说明和功能分组。

### 修复
- 修复私信列表中同一联系人可能重复显示的问题，覆盖缓存恢复、刷新及分页加载场景。
- 修复已安装测试版选择稳定版更新渠道时，错误展示旧稳定版更新日志、发布日期和 Release 链接的问题。
- 修正关于页的版本类型与更新渠道说明，避免测试版安装包被误认为稳定版。
- 修复手机快捷入口图标缺失。
- 修复系统榜首屏内容不足时不继续加载下一页，以及双列瀑布流滚动抽动、短列加载不及时的问题。
- 修复切换应用窗口标签后话题列表意外刷新的问题。
- 修复头条刷新和分页时游标传递异常。
- 修复私信图片预览及输入区高度调节问题。
- 修复详情评论点赞状态的主题色显示，以及话题简介文字与背景对比度不足的问题。
- 修复私信列表已收到新消息、当前聊天窗口却未及时更新的问题，现在会自动同步聊天内容，并在展示后更新已读状态；同步时保留输入草稿和历史消息阅读位置。
